@🚨 Breaking Pings 
Following the previous statement made by the GIE leader and founder of the coalition, TWO factions have been expelled from the coalition, one of which being the AOCTL.

The reasoning is plentiful, however the primary reason was the resulting self-doubt and cowardice that comes from a protracted conflict. They were mad attack dogs who were, at the time, extremely useful. It was only recently that their leader started to express doubt regarding the future of their faction if they were to sustain this level of war for a long period of time.

They have since attempted to ally themselves with Hawazen against us, who actually then rejected their alliance.

I encourage all those who are forced to fight a war they did not start, just like what happened to us, to reach out in private. We will stand by you whatever happens.

# **S.D.U. | OFFICIAL ANNOUNCEMENT**

WITHDRAWAL FROM THE COALITION

The Sovereign Defence Union (S.D.U.) officially announces its decision to withdraw from the coalition.

THIS IS NOT A DECISION MADE OUT OF WEAKNESS, BUT OUT OF STRATEGY.

Our primary objective is to stimulate economic growth, strengthen our treasury, and further develop our faction.

 WAR STATUS

HAWAZAN: The S.D.U. will participate in one final battle on 07 November 2026 19:00. We expect this engagement to be a FAIR 3v3, with equal numbers on both sides. Our final offensive will end at 07 November 2026 19:30, after which we will withdraw from the war entirely.

BCC: We will immediately withdraw from the war against BCC, as we have never meaningfully engaged in combat with them, and no justified reason for their declaration of war was provided to us.

 OUR FUTURE

The S.D.U. remains committed to defensive principles, economic prosperity, and the security of its members.

OUR PRIORITY IS NOT ENDLESS WARFARE. OUR PRIORITY IS BUILDING A STRONGER FUTURE.

 S.D.U. — UNITED IN PURPOSE. STRONG IN DEFENCE.
 
**Author Vixnloris**
